_about: The planet sizes the first run can be asked for (--size small|medium|big|default|all; tools/first-run/first-run.mjs). A size is chosen the way a player chooses it, with the setup's "Planet size" row (a locked build takes no argument for it): `keys` are pressed after the fighter pick and before Start, with the setup's first row lit before and after (four Down to the row, Left to the smaller size or Right to the bigger one from Medium, four Up back). `args`: extra arguments for the program (none needed today). A row is used only on a build that offers the size: the script reads that from the program's own data and otherwise reports 'not offered by this build'.

default.what: the planet this build starts with (medium)

small.what: one Left on the Planet size row

medium.what: the size the setup starts on

big.what: one Right on the Planet size row
